services.name: Regional Paramedical Services (RPS)
services.evidence: EMS/Rescue Squads Carbon Hill Volunteer Rescue Squad Regional Paramedics Ambulance Service Walker County Volunteer Rescue Squad

01127.page_note: Regional Paramedical Services (RPS) is the ambulance service that answers 911 calls in Walker County. City fire departments and volunteer rescue squads respond to medical calls but do not transport.
01127.second_source: https://abc3340.com/news/local/woman-dies-waiting-on-ambulance-after-911-call-industry-leaders-call-for-more-funding-walker-county-ems-emergency-medical (2024-06-18: "there was no other ambulance service to roll over to. Walker County 911 confirmed the call was transferred to RPS successfully for ambulance service")

services.name: Keller EMS (Helen Keller Hospital, HH Health System)
services.evidence: Emergency Medical Services Keller Ambulance Service Air Evac Lifeteam Paid Fire Departments Muscle Shoals Fire Department Sheffield Fire Department Tuscumbia Fire Department

01033.page_note: Keller EMS, run by Helen Keller Hospital, is the ground ambulance service for Colbert County 911. The Muscle Shoals, Sheffield and Tuscumbia fire departments and the volunteer fire departments respond but do not transport.
01033.second_source: https://www.waff.com/2025/06/11/keller-ems-becomes-first-shoals-offer-blood-transfusions-field/ (2025-06-11: "Keller EMS becomes the first ground ambulance service in the Shoals to carry and provide blood")

services.name: Haynes Ambulance of Macon County
services.evidence: One firefighter was evaluated and transported by Haynes Ambulance of Alabama from the scene with minor injuries.

01087.page_note: Haynes Ambulance runs the ambulance service in Macon County, with stations in the county, and transports patients from emergency scenes there. It is the only ambulance service licensed in the county. Local volunteer fire departments respond but do not transport.
01087.second_source: https://www.lowndessignal.com/news/ivey-announces-first-grants-of-new-rural-healthcare-program-ab505510 (2026-08-24 grants: "Haynes Ambulance of Alabama Inc. was granted $283,314 to strengthen cybersecurity and information technology systems across its rural emergency medical service stations to protect patient information and improve operational reliability in eight counties: Bullock, Covington, Crenshaw, Elmore, Lowndes, Macon, Pike, Tallapoosa."); https://www.wsfa.com/2018/09/29/haynes-ambulance-start-serving-macon-county-monday/ (2018: Haynes replaced CARE Ambulance in Macon County)

services.name: Haynes Ambulance (Haynes Ambulance of Troy, LLC - Lowndes)
services.evidence: Blair said his department responded to the call where they discovered the river on passenger side of the vehicle. The individual was transported for treatment by Haynes Ambulance.

01085.page_note: Haynes Ambulance runs the ambulance service in Lowndes County, with stations in the county, and transports patients from emergency scenes there. It is the only ambulance service licensed in the county.
01085.second_source: https://www.lowndessignal.com/news/ivey-announces-additional-55m-rural-health-grants-e69bf22a (2026-10: "An organization serving Lowndes County, Haynes Ambulance of Alabama Inc., received a $1.4 million EMS Trauma and Stroke Initiative award"); https://www.lowndessignal.com/news/ivey-announces-first-grants-of-new-rural-healthcare-program-ab505510 (2026-08: Haynes rural emergency medical service stations in eight counties including Lowndes); https://www.wsfa.com/2020/07/02/new-ambulance-service-coming-lowndes-county/ (2020: county and Haynes agreed a contract)

services.name: Perry County Ambulance Service (PC Ambulance, Inc.)
services.evidence: Perry County's new county-owned ambulance service has been operating since July 11 ... For citizens needing ambulance service, nothing has changed. You just dial 911 as usual.
services.vintage: 2023 (no sign of change; it holds the county's only transport licence, 2026)

01105.page_note: Perry County runs its own ambulance service, which answers 911 calls across the county, including Marion and Uniontown.

services.name: Atrium Health Floyd Cherokee EMS
services.evidence: Atrium Health Floyd operates rural health clinics in Piedmont and Centre, providing primary and urgent care services, and is the E-911 ambulance provider for Cherokee County with three EMS stations covering the county.

01019.page_note: Atrium Health Floyd is the 911 ambulance provider for Cherokee County. Not yet confirmed: whether Piedmont Rescue & EMS also carries patients from the Cherokee County part of Piedmont.
01019.second_source: https://abc3340.com/news/local/new-ambulance-service-servicing-cherokee-county (2018: "After the evaluation process was done, Floyd EMS was awarded the bid")

01093.page_note: Marion County EMS is the only ambulance service based in the county. The county 911 centre says it works with two emergency medical services; the second one is not yet confirmed.
01093.second_source: https://www.marion911.org/ ("We also coordinate with 2 emergency medical services, 4 air-ambulance services")

01049.page_note: DeKalb Ambulance Service is the only ambulance service based in the county, but a current public page naming it as the county's 911 ambulance provider has not been found yet.
01049.second_source: https://www.waff.com/2024/11/19/dekalb-ambulance-service-offering-home-holidays-program/ (2024, names the DeKalb Ambulance Service area but not its 911 role)

01071.page_note: Highlands EMS, run by Highlands Medical Center, is the only ground ambulance service based in the county, but a public page naming it as the 911 ambulance provider for the whole county has not been found yet.

01031.page_note: Enterprise Rescue says its ground operations are based in Coffee County and it is the only ground ambulance service licensed there. Not yet confirmed: that it covers all of the county, including Elba and the Fort Novosel area.
01031.second_source: https://enterpriserescue.com/ ("Enterprise Rescue provides 24/7 pre-hospital ambulance services to thousands of citizens across South Alabama with ground operations based in Coffee, Monroe, Clarke and Butler counties")
